label: Shaphan

text.BHSA 2KI 22:13: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֣י וּבְעַד־הָעָ֗ם וּבְעַד֙ כָּל־יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל־דִּבְרֵ֛י הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַנִּמְצָ֖א הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־גְדֹולָ֞ה חֲמַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא֙ נִצְּתָ֣ה בָ֔נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־שָׁמְע֜וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗ינוּ עַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֔ה לַעֲשֹׂ֖ות כְּכָל־הַכָּת֥וּב עָלֵֽינוּ׃
text.KJV 2KI 22:13: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
text.BHSA 2KI 22:14: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ֠כֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָ֨ם וְעַכְבֹּ֜ור וְשָׁפָ֣ן וַעֲשָׂיָ֗ה אֶל־חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת׀ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־תִּקְוָ֗ה בֶּן־חַרְחַס֙ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְהִ֛יא יֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַֽיְדַבְּר֖וּ אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
text.KJV 2KI 22:14: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
text.BHSA 2KI 22:15: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּֽה־אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
text.KJV 2KI 22:15: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

A.name: Shaphan
A.notes: He was sent to repair the house of the Lord (2CH 34:8)
family: scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)
grandfather-of gedaliah (Gedaliah, son of Ahikam, appointed King of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar (2K)

B.name: Shaphan
B.line: Secretary/scribe of King Josiah who read the found law-book to him.
family: companion-of hilkiah-2 (Hilkiah, the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9))
scribe-of josiah (Josiah, prophesied son of the house of David (1KI 13:2), King of Jud)

why: The Hebrew names Shaphan once in the delegation with Hilkiah and Ahikam concerning the discovered book, consistent with A, Josiah’s scribe and Ahikam’s father. However, B has the same king, office, and father as A, so the supplied facts do not securely distinguish the two records.
